# Typography

Use repository type tokens and fonts first. Otherwise use the system UI stack and this scale (size/line-height): body `16/24px`, small `14/20px`, caption `12/16px`, h3 `20/28px`, h2 `24/32px`, h1 `32/40px` compact and `40/48px` wide.

- Body weight 400; labels and emphasis 500–600; headings 600–700. Avoid weight below 400 for essential text.
- Keep body measure at 45–75 characters (target 65ch). Left-align paragraphs; never justify UI copy.
- Use one `h1`, preserve semantic heading order, and do not use heading styles solely for appearance.
- Support 200% text zoom without clipping, overlap, or loss of controls. Allow labels and buttons to wrap where localization can expand copy.
- Use tabular numerals for comparable metrics; reserve uppercase for short labels and add letter spacing rather than uppercase paragraphs.
